# Finding Balance Counseling

> Texas practice led by Reem Glasco, LPC-S (license 66562), based in Austin and working online statewide. The practice is primarily for therapists: LPC Associates seeking supervision, therapists seeking EMDRIA-approved EMDR consultation, and clinicians attending retreats or training. Reem also holds a small therapy caseload for developmental trauma, C-PTSD, anxiety and depression, with the practice's LPC Associates seeing additional clients at lower fees.

Key facts, current as of 2026-10-29:

- LPC Supervisor in Texas since 2009; over 15 years of clinical experience.
- LPC supervision is $425 a month and includes three individual hours and one group hour, four hours in total, online, statewide in Texas.
- Supervision openings: one in spring 2027. Agency contracts of three months are $500 a month.
- EMDRIA Approved Consultant. Individual EMDR consultation is $185, online.
- Individual therapy is $240 for a 50-minute online session, self-pay. Blue Cross Blue Shield is accepted; other plans are self-pay.
- Trail walk and movement therapy is $125 for a one-hour session, in person in Texas, adults only.
- Modalities: IFS-informed EMDR (the clinical focus), Somatic Experiencing (SEP), NARM, EMDR certified with ASSYST, PRECI and IGTP-OTS, Brainspotting, BASE-P.
- Optional equine-assisted supervision and mindfulness retreats near Dripping Springs, Texas; equine supervision sessions are $60 each.
- Annual mindful trail retreat for interns, associates and licensed therapists, plus periodic ethics CEUs for Texas LPCs.
- The site publishes a free Texas LPC licensure guide: 3,000 supervised hours, 1,500 direct, an 18-month minimum, four supervision hours a month, no more than 50% group, and a 60-month expiry on the LPC Associate license (22 TAC 681.92).

- [Home](https://reemglascolpc.com/): Reem Glasco, LPC-S, has supervised Texas LPC Associates since 2009. Online supervision, EMDRIA-approved EMDR consultation, retreats and equine work.
- [For Therapists](https://reemglascolpc.com/for-therapists/): Three ways therapists work with Reem Glasco, LPC-S: LPC supervision at $425 a month, EMDR consultation at $185, and retreats and equine training in Texas.
  - [LPC Supervision](https://reemglascolpc.com/for-therapists/lpc-supervision/): Online LPC supervision for Texas LPC Associates with Reem Glasco, LPC-S, supervisor since 2009. $425 a month for three individual hours and one group hour.
  - [EMDR Consultation](https://reemglascolpc.com/for-therapists/emdr-consultation/): EMDR consultation toward certification with Reem Glasco, LPC-S, an EMDRIA Approved Consultant. Individual online consults are $185, IFS-informed.
  - [Retreats & Training](https://reemglascolpc.com/for-therapists/retreats-training/): Mindful trail retreats, equine-assisted training and ethics CEUs for Texas therapists, interns and LPC Associates, led by Reem Glasco, LPC-S, near Austin.
  - [Ethics CEUs](https://reemglascolpc.com/for-therapists/ethics-ceus/): Ethics continuing education for Texas LPCs with Reem Glasco, LPC-S. One CEU online or two in person on a trail walk among horses, on secondary trauma.
- [Licensure Guide](https://reemglascolpc.com/texas-lpc-licensure/): The Texas LPC path in full: 3,000 hours, 1,500 direct, the 18-month floor, the four-hour monthly supervision rule and the group cap, plus choosing a supervisor.
- [Therapy](https://reemglascolpc.com/therapy/): Therapy in Texas for developmental trauma, C-PTSD, anxiety and depression with Reem Glasco, LPC-S, or with the practice's associates at lower fees.
  - [Equine Therapy](https://reemglascolpc.com/therapy/equine/): Equine-assisted therapy near Dripping Springs with Reem Glasco, LPC-S. Sessions with horses for adults, after a consult and one to three online sessions.
  - [Walk and Talk](https://reemglascolpc.com/therapy/walk-and-talk/): Trail walk and movement therapy in central Texas with Reem Glasco, LPC-S. Adults only, Fridays, one hour, $125 a session.
  - [Trauma](https://reemglascolpc.com/therapy/trauma/): Therapy for developmental trauma and C-PTSD in Texas with Reem Glasco, LPC-S. IFS-informed EMDR, Somatic Experiencing and NARM, online at $240 a session.
  - [Anxiety](https://reemglascolpc.com/therapy/anxiety/): Therapy for anxiety, panic attacks and social anxiety in Texas with Reem Glasco, LPC-S, or the practice's associates at lower fees. Online statewide, $240.
  - [Associates](https://reemglascolpc.com/therapy/associates/): Meet the LPC Associates at Finding Balance Counseling, supervised by Reem Glasco, LPC-S. Fees from $100 a session with sliding scale, online across Texas.
  - [Depression](https://reemglascolpc.com/therapy/depression/): Therapy for depression, flatness and procrastination in Texas with Reem Glasco, LPC-S. Trauma-informed and body-based, online statewide at $240 a session.
- [Approach](https://reemglascolpc.com/approach/): The four methods Reem Glasco, LPC-S, works with: NARM, Somatic Experiencing, EMDR and IFS-informed EMDR. What each does, and when she reaches for it.
  - [NARM](https://reemglascolpc.com/approach/narm/): NARM therapy in Texas with Reem Glasco, LPC-S. What the NeuroAffective Relational Model is, who it suits, and how it treats developmental trauma.
  - [Somatic Experiencing](https://reemglascolpc.com/approach/somatic-experiencing/): Somatic Experiencing in Texas with Reem Glasco, LPC-S, a Somatic Experiencing Practitioner. Body-based trauma therapy in small doses, online statewide.
  - [EMDR](https://reemglascolpc.com/approach/emdr/): EMDR therapy with Reem Glasco, LPC-S, EMDR certified and an EMDRIA Approved Consultant. Online across Texas, $240 a session, Blue Cross Blue Shield accepted.
  - [IFS-Informed EMDR](https://reemglascolpc.com/approach/ifs-informed-emdr/): IFS-informed EMDR with Reem Glasco, LPC-S. Parts work combined with EMDR for developmental trauma, for people whose EMDR has flooded, stalled or gone nowhere.
- [The Book](https://reemglascolpc.com/book/): Effort-less Self-Care: 7 Easy Steps to Calm and Connection, by Reem Glasco, LPC-S. A gentle workbook for slowing down and listening to your body.
  - [The Practice](https://reemglascolpc.com/book/practice/): Walk through the seven steps of Effort-less Self-Care with a breathing guide, two short timers and journal prompts that save privately in your own browser.
- [About](https://reemglascolpc.com/about/): Reem Glasco is a Texas LPC Supervisor since 2009, NARM therapist, Somatic Experiencing Practitioner and EMDRIA Approved Consultant, in Austin.
- [FAQ](https://reemglascolpc.com/faq/): What therapy costs in Texas with and without insurance, the full fee list, and plain answers on somatic therapy, EMDR, complex PTSD and getting started.
- [Blog](https://reemglascolpc.com/blog/): Writing from Reem Glasco, LPC-S, on boundaries, the nervous system, trauma work and the business of being a therapist in Texas.
  - [How to Set Healthy Boundaries](https://reemglascolpc.com/blog/healthy-boundaries/): Five steps to setting boundaries that hold: identify your limits, say them plainly, read your own feelings, and get help if they keep collapsing.
  - [What Makes Supervision Trauma-Informed](https://reemglascolpc.com/blog/trauma-informed-supervision/): Trauma-informed supervision treats the supervisee's own nervous system as part of the work. What that changes about case presentation, pacing and shame in the supervision hour.
  - [Is Equine Therapy Covered by Insurance?](https://reemglascolpc.com/blog/equine-therapy-insurance-cost/): No. Equine-assisted psychotherapy has no billing code of its own, which is why insurance does not cover it. Why that is, what to ask your own plan, and what sessions cost here.
  - [Why Walk and Talk Therapy Works](https://reemglascolpc.com/blog/walk-and-talk-therapy/): Walking side by side changes what is possible to say. Why movement and the absence of eye contact help some people talk, and who outdoor therapy is not a good fit for.
